text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down over 2% in the past day, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, suggesting mild risk-off sentiment across the majors. The Fear & Greed index sits at 11—extreme fear territory—and has deteriorated by 18 points over the week, indicating sustained pessimism rather than a quick panic dip. Bitcoin dominance remains elevated at 58%, and while $71B in daily volume is moderate, the combination of falling prices, extreme fear, and tightening dominance points to a defensive market where traders are rotating toward the safest asset.
